<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>停用账号编辑弹框 — 补充出编/离职信息方案 v4</title>
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+SC:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap');
  * { margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }
  body { font-family: 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif; background:#F1F5F9; color:#1E293B; padding:30px; }
  h1 { font-size:22px; margin-bottom:4px; }
  .subtitle { color:#64748B; font-size:13px; margin-bottom:24px; }
  h2 { font-size:16px; margin:24px 0 10px; padding-bottom:6px; border-bottom:1px solid #E2E8F0; }
  h3 { font-size:13px; margin:14px 0 6px; color:#1E40AF; }
  table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:11px; margin:8px 0; }
  th { background:#F8FAFC; padding:6px 8px; text-align:left; font-weight:600; color:#64748B; border-bottom:1px solid #E2E8F0; }
  td { padding:6px 8px; border-bottom:1px solid #F1F5F9; vertical-align:top; }
  .anno { font-size:11px; color:#64748B; background:#F8FAFC; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:6px; margin:8px 0; border-left:3px solid #3B82F6; line-height:1.6; }

  .mockup { background:#fff; border-radius:12px; box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); overflow:hidden; max-width:500px; margin:10px 0; }
  .mockup-topbar { background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1E3A8A,#1E40AF); height:26px; display:flex; align-items:center; padding:0 10px; gap:5px; }
  .mockup-topbar .dot { width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; }
  .mockup-topbar .dot.r { background:#EF4444; } .mockup-topbar .dot.y { background:#F59E0B; } .mockup-topbar .dot.g { background:#10B981; }
  .mockup-topbar .title-bar { color:rgba(255,255,255,0.5); font-size:9px; margin-left:4px; }
  .mockup-body { padding:12px; font-size:12px; }

  fieldset { border:1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius:6px; padding:8px; margin-bottom:6px; }
  legend { font-size:10px; font-weight:600; color:#1E40AF; padding:0 4px; }

  .info-card { border-radius:6px; padding:10px 14px; margin:8px 0; }
  .info-card.exit { background:#FFF5F5; border:1px solid #FECACA; }
  .info-card.manual { background:#F8FAFC; border:1px solid #E2E8F0; }
  .info-card .card-title { font-size:11px; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:6px; }
  .info-card.exit .card-title { color:#991B1B; }
  .info-card.manual .card-title { color:#64748B; }
  .info-row { display:flex; gap:8px; font-size:11px; padding:2px 0; }
  .info-label { color:#94A3B8; min-width:70px; }
  .info-value { color:#1E293B; font-weight:500; }

  .hl-box { border:2px dashed #F59E0B; border-radius:6px; padding:6px; position:relative; }
  .hl-box::before { content:'新增'; position:absolute; top:-10px; left:8px; background:#F59E0B; color:#fff; font-size:9px; padding:1px 6px; border-radius:3px; font-weight:600; }

  .fg { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px; }
  .fg label { font-size:9px; color:#64748B; }
  .fg .val { font-size:11px; font-weight:500; padding:3px 0; }
  .grid2 { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:6px 12px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<h1>停用账号编辑弹框 — 补充出编/离职信息方案 v4</h1>
<p class="subtitle">account-management.html · 数据模型 + 编辑弹框 · 暂不改代码</p>

<!-- ===== 需求 ===== -->
<h2>一、核心思路</h2>

<div class="anno">
  <strong>关键变化：</strong>出编/离职/手动停用的信息，在账号停用时<strong>直接写入 teacher_accounts 记录</strong>，不再每次去 exit_records / contract_exit_records 跨表查询。编辑弹框直接从账号记录读取展示。
</div>

<!-- ===== 数据模型 ===== -->
<h2>二、teacher_accounts 新增字段</h2>

<p style="font-size:12px;color:#64748B;">在现有账号记录中新增以下字段，停用时由对应的业务流程写入：</p>

<table>
  <thead><tr><th>字段</th><th>类型</th><th>写入时机</th><th>说明</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr><td><code>disableType</code></td><td>string</td><td>停用时写入</td><td><code>'exit'</code>（出编停用）/ <code>'contract_end'</code>（离职停用）/ <code>'manual'</code>（手动停用）</td></tr>
    <tr><td><code>disableReason</code></td><td>string</td><td>停用时写入</td><td>出编：出编形式（退休/调动/辞职…）<br>离职：离职类型<br>手动：操作人填写的停用原因</td></tr>
    <tr><td><code>disableDate</code></td><td>string</td><td>停用时写入</td><td>停用日期（YYYY-MM-DD 或完整时间戳）</td></tr>
    <tr><td><code>disableOperator</code></td><td>string</td><td>停用时写入</td><td>操作人姓名</td></tr>
    <tr><td><code>contractStart</code></td><td>string</td><td>合同制入职时写入</td><td>合同开始日期，仅合同制教师有</td></tr>
    <tr><td><code>contractEnd</code></td><td>string</td><td>合同制入职时写入</td><td>合同结束日期，仅合同制教师有</td></tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

<h3>2.1 完整账号记录示例</h3>

<div class="anno">
  <strong>出编停用（事业编）：</strong>
  <pre style="font-size:10px;margin:4px 0;">{
  accountId: 'TEA20260601006',
  name: '赵志华', staffingType: '控制数', status: 'disabled',
  <span style="color:#EF4444;">disableType: 'exit',           // 出编停用
  disableReason: '调动',           // 出编形式
  disableDate: '2026-05-17',
  disableOperator: '周敏',</span>
  exitRecords: ['OC20260601001']   // 保留关联 ID
}</pre>

  <strong>离职停用（合同制）：</strong>
  <pre style="font-size:10px;margin:4px 0;">{
  accountId: '...', name: '...', staffingType: '合同制', status: 'disabled',
  <span style="color:#EF4444;">disableType: 'contract_end',    // 离职停用
  disableReason: '合同到期不续签',  // 离职类型
  disableDate: '2026-07-01',
  disableOperator: '王玉兰',
  contractStart: '2024-07-01',     // 入职时写入
  contractEnd: '2026-07-01',       // 入职时写入</span>
  exitRecords: ['CE20260701001']
}</pre>

  <strong>手动停用：</strong>
  <pre style="font-size:10px;margin:4px 0;">{
  accountId: '...', name: '...', status: 'disabled',
  <span style="color:#EF4444;">disableType: 'manual',          // 手动停用
  disableReason: '违规操作',        // 管理员填写的原因
  disableDate: '2026-06-20 14:30',
  disableOperator: '张建国',</span>
  exitRecords: []                  // 无关联出编记录
}</pre>
</div>

<!-- ===== 各流程写入时机 ===== -->
<h2>三、各流程写入时机</h2>

<table>
  <thead><tr><th>流程</th><th>触发点</th><th>写入的字段</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <td>教师出编审批通过</td>
      <td><code>exit-audit.html</code> / <code>exit-detail.html</code> 审批通过时</td>
      <td><code>status='disabled'</code>, <code>disableType='exit'</code>, <code>disableReason=exitForm</code>, <code>disableDate=approvedAt</code>, <code>disableOperator=审批人</code></td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td>编外教师离职审批通过</td>
      <td><code>contract-exit-detail.html</code> 审批通过时</td>
      <td><code>status='disabled'</code>, <code>disableType='contract_end'</code>, <code>disableReason=离职类型</code>, <code>disableDate=approvedAt</code>, <code>disableOperator=审批人</code></td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td>编外教师入职</td>
      <td><code>contract-entry-detail.html</code> 审批通过时</td>
      <td><code>contractStart</code>, <code>contractEnd</code></td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td>管理员手动停用</td>
      <td><code>account-management.html</code> disableAccount()</td>
      <td><code>status='disabled'</code>, <code>disableType='manual'</code>, <code>disableReason=弹框输入</code>, <code>disableDate=now</code>, <code>disableOperator=currentUser.name</code></td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td>管理员恢复账号</td>
      <td><code>account-management.html</code> restoreAccount()</td>
      <td><code>status='active'</code>, 清空 <code>disableType/disableReason/disableDate/disableOperator</code></td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

<!-- ===== 界面不变 ===== -->
<h2>四、编辑弹框展示（数据源简化）</h2>

<p style="font-size:12px;color:#64748B;">界面与 v3 相同，但数据来源从"跨表查询"变为"直接读取账号字段"：</p>

<table>
  <thead><tr><th>卡片</th><th>展示字段</th><th>数据来源（v3）</th><th>数据来源（v4）</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr><td>🔒 出编信息</td><td>出编形式 + 出编日期 + 操作人</td><td>exit_records 跨表查询</td><td><strong>a.disableReason + a.disableDate + a.disableOperator</strong></td></tr>
    <tr><td>📋 离职信息</td><td>离职类型 + 离职日期 + 操作人</td><td>contract_exit_records 跨表查询</td><td><strong>a.disableReason + a.disableDate + a.disableOperator</strong></td></tr>
    <tr><td>⏸ 停用信息</td><td>停用方式 + 停用时间 + 操作人 + 原因</td><td>statusReason + 建议新增字段</td><td><strong>a.disableReason + a.disableDate + a.disableOperator</strong></td></tr>
    <tr><td>📅 合同期限</td><td>合同起止时间</td><td>contract_entry_records 跨表查询</td><td><strong>a.contractStart + a.contractEnd</strong></td></tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

<h3>4.1 buildStatusCard 伪代码（简化版）</h3>

<div class="anno">
<pre style="font-size:10px;margin:0;">function buildStatusCard(a) {
  if (a.status !== 'disabled') return '';

  var type = a.disableType || '';
  var reason = a.disableReason || a.statusReason || '—';
  var date = a.disableDate || '—';
  var operator = a.disableOperator || '—';

  if (type === 'exit') {
    // 🔒 出编信息
    return card('🔒 出编信息', [
      {label:'出编形式', value:reason},
      {label:'出编日期', value:date},
      {label:'操作人',   value:operator}
    ], 'exit');
  }
  if (type === 'contract_end') {
    // 📋 离职信息
    return card('📋 离职信息', [
      {label:'离职类型', value:reason},
      {label:'离职日期', value:date},
      {label:'操作人',   value:operator}
    ], 'exit');
  }
  // manual / 兜底
  return card('⏸ 停用信息', [
    {label:'停用方式', value: type==='manual' ? '手动停用' : '自动停用'},
    {label:'停用时间', value:date},
    {label:'操作人',   value:operator},
    {label:'停用原因', value:reason}
  ], 'manual');
}
</pre>
</div>

<!-- ===== 实现清单 ===== -->
<h2>五、实现清单</h2>

<table>
  <thead><tr><th>#</th><th>改动</th><th>文件</th><th>说明</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr><td>1</td><td><strong>teacher_accounts 新增 6 个字段</strong></td><td>account-management.html</td><td>disableType / disableReason / disableDate / disableOperator / contractStart / contractEnd，迁移时补默认值</td></tr>
    <tr><td>2</td><td><strong>disableAccount() 写入停用信息</strong></td><td>account-management.html</td><td>弹出原因输入框，写入 disableType='manual' 等字段</td></tr>
    <tr><td>3</td><td><strong>restoreAccount() 清空停用信息</strong></td><td>account-management.html</td><td>恢复时将 disableType/Reason/Date/Operator 置空</td></tr>
    <tr><td>4</td><td>editAccount 模板新增 <strong>buildStatusCard(a)</strong></td><td>account-management.html</td><td>仅 status=disabled 时渲染，读 disableType 区分三种卡片</td></tr>
    <tr><td>5</td><td>岗位信息新增<strong>合同期限只读行</strong></td><td>account-management.html</td><td>仅合同制显示，读 a.contractStart / a.contractEnd</td></tr>
    <tr><td>6</td><td><strong>出编审批通过时写入</strong> disable 字段</td><td>exit-audit.html / exit-detail.html</td><td>审批通过后找到对应 teacher_accounts 记录并更新</td></tr>
    <tr><td>7</td><td><strong>离职审批通过时写入</strong> disable 字段</td><td>contract-exit-detail.html</td><td>审批通过后找到对应 teacher_accounts 记录并更新</td></tr>
    <tr><td>8</td><td><strong>合同制入职时写入</strong> contractStart/End</td><td>contract-entry-detail.html</td><td>审批通过后将合同起止时间写入 teacher_accounts</td></tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

<div class="anno">
  <strong>迁移兼容：</strong>现有已停用账号（如赵志华）只有 statusReason='教师出编冻结'，无新增字段。<br>
  首次加载时迁移逻辑：若 status=disabled 且 disableType 为空 → 尝试从 exitRecords 回填（查 exit_records），查不到则标记为 disableType='unknown'。<br>
  后续新停用的账号直接走新逻辑写入。
</div>

</body>
</html>
